text_block_list.text:
âWonder Acute has challenged the undisputed dirt champion, Smart Falcon,
three times in Gâ  races, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my goodness~. It's written right here in this magazine too.
Three consecutive GⅠ wins against Falco-san..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Things went almost too well, didn't they? It's all thanks to you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: No, this is a feat achieved by the both of you!
No, it's a triumph for both of us!

text_block_list.text: "Convincing victories in the JBC Classic, the Tokyo Daishoten, and the Kawasaki Kinen."
It was a truly flawless result. With a performance like this, no one would dare call it a fluke.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Winning is fine and all...
but look at the kinds of things they're writing about me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: They called me Falco-san's "natural enemy."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, that sounds a bit dangerous.
I don't really care for natural enemies or IV drips, you see~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aha☆ Don't worry about it at all, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, Falco-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I don't think of you as an Umadol Buster at all, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If anything... it's the opposite.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Can you guess who I think
Acute-san resembles the most?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Close to whom...? You mean,
like someone I resemble? Well, let me see...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: A Momotaro chasing after someone?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"T-That's not quite it, maybe...
Here's how I think about it!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Like a fan who follows me with all their heart♪
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Here! A present from me♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Th-This is, um...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A signed fan☆
Packed with extra love.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for always chasing after me with all your might so I don't lose focus♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even with my skills, Acute-san is the one person
who always manages to catch me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: O-O-Ooooh, this is... quite the blessed "rare merch", isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me to have this?
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer.
Look, look..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Swish swish swish swish~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, exactly!
Accute-san is just so cute...!

Wonder Acute was overjoyed
to receive the commemorative fan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san. Falco-san
said that to praise me, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I kind of feel like the reason I can put on a good race every time
is all thanks to Falco-san."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Because Falco-san is strong,
so all I have to do each time is race with my eyes set on you, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Falco-san doesn't have a goal like that.
And yet, completely fearless, she's running right at the very front...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I get the feeling that's what true strength,
true courage really is, you know?"

...Indeed, that was true. Having a clear goal
makes racing considerably easier.

The reason I managed to run well all three times
was thanks to Smart Falcon running up ahead for me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Earth to Falco, earth to Falco-chan.
Thinking about it that way, I'm still...
I still have so, so far to go...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I haven't caught up to you at all, y'know.
Your back... still seems so far away.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, to have received...
this fan like this..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly blessed.
Yes, this fan is..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon, Wonder Acute!
Smart Falcon, Wonder Acute!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Can Wonder Acute catch her!?
Can Smart Falcon hold on!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Truly a fiery, blazing dead heeeaaat!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This fan is a keepsake of our competition, isn't it...
How could I ever forget it?
None of us ever will.
